items.title: Brazil's elections matter for the planet. This is why
items.titleOrig: Brazil's elections matter for the planet. This is why
items.desc: Brazil is heading back to the polls, but the impact could be felt worldwide. With the Amazon vital to the health of the planet, the election could help shape its future.

items.title: India news: Supreme Court hears Rahul Gandhi's Election Commission plea
items.titleOrig: India news: Supreme Court hears Rahul Gandhi's Election Commission plea
items.desc: A petition filed by opposition leader Rahul Gandhi and others seeks an independent audit of India's sweeping voter deletions. Meanwhile, actor Imran Khan has reportedly been ordered to leave India. DW has more.

items.title: Why Chinese tech brands are outpacing Western rivals from EVs to robot vacuums
items.titleOrig: Why Chinese tech brands are outpacing Western rivals from EVs to robot vacuums
items.desc: From action cameras and smartphones to EVs and robot vacuums, Chinese brands are gaining ground worldwide despite privacy and security concerns. What's driving their rise, and can European rivals keep up?

items.titleOrig: Manchester City, the UAE and the UK's OM in a political tangle
items.desc: Nearly 20 years after arriving in England, Manchester City's UAE owners could exit amid cheating charges. That would pose a challenge for a city — and prime minister — closely tied to Abu Dhabi.

items.title: North Korea, China open border bridge after 12-year delay
items.titleOrig: North Korea, China open border bridge after 12-year delay
items.desc: Twelve years after it was constructed, the New Yalu River Bridge between China and North Korea is finally operational. It is the latest sign of warming ties between the two nations.

items.titleOrig: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
items.desc: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.
